log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Plan: Mirror match, we are max speed on most. Bring special Gholdengo immune to status, Mimikyu with Disguise+priority to kill dragons/Gholdengo, Scarf Garchomp fastest revenge. Lead Gholdengo to setup or trade, save Garchomp for late cleanup.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Pokémon team stats and moves to determine speed tiers and strategy against a mirrored opponent.Calculating exact speed tiers and identifying the slowest Rotom-Wash as a mirror disadvantage.Extending the speed analysis to mirror matchups and type interactions for core selection.Evaluating type matchups and priority interactions to narrow the trio selection.Adjusting the trio to add a special attacker immune to status for type and role balance.Comparing Mimikyu and Dragonite for priority and coverage against Dragon types.Evaluating Kingambit and Mimikyu priority matchups against Gholdengo and selecting the lead.Comparing Garchomp, Mimikyu, and Gholdengo lead matchups against Kingambit and Garchomp.

decisions.thought: Plan: Gholdengo fears Shadow Claw and can't break Disguise without wasting Make It Rain drop. Switch to own Mimikyu to absorb hit with Disguise. Expect mirror Mimikyu with Life Orb, SD + Shadow Claw/Play Rough. Save Scarf Garchomp for late cleanup.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing team matchup and contradictory opponent team preview details for Pokemon Champions singles.Resolving contradictory team composition details by using the battle log to identify the actual opponent lineup.Resolving type matchup calculations and speed tier uncertainty for the Gholdengo versus Mimikyu lead.Evaluating switch options and damage risks after ruling out attacking into Disguise.

decisions.thought: Plan: Down +2 in mirror, can't win straight. Break their Disguise with priority Sneak now, take only 1/8 via own Disguise. Then revenge broken Mimikyu with Scarf Garchomp Poison Jab or Gholdengo. Save Garchomp for cleanup.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing a Pokémon mirror matchup with both Mimikyu at full HP and disguise intact to compare Swords Dance and Shadow Claw options.Evaluating Swords Dance versus Shadow Claw in a disguised Mimikyu mirror matchup given team list inconsistency.Analyzing disguise interaction and switch options for the Mimikyu mirror matchup.Evaluating damage and priority interactions for the Mimikyu mirror and switch options.

decisions.thought: Plan: Foe Mimikyu +4, disguise broken, we still have disguise. Can't switch Gholdengo/Garchomp into +4 STAB safely. Stay and KO with Shadow Claw, our disguise tanks one hit. Sneak too weak to KO. Expect Shadow Claw/Sneak or third SD.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing battle log to confirm opponent Mimikyu's disguise is broken at 87% HP while ours remains intact against +4 attack.Evaluating priority move damage against reduced HP while accounting for speed tie risk.Comparing Shadow Sneak and Shadow Claw damage versus speed tie and priority interactions.

decisions.thought: Plan: Preserve Mimikyu disguise for late game. Rotom threatens burn and bulky waters, bad matchup. Gholdengo immune to status via Good as Gold, resists and can Nasty Plot on Rotom. Save Scarf Garchomp for cleanup vs unknown Gholdengo/Kingambit/Dragonite/Garchomp.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing battle state to confirm Mimikyu’s disguise is intact and assessing opponent Rotom-Wash move probabilities under mirrored team constraints.Resolving team roster contradiction and evaluating Will-O-Wisp status interaction with disguise before choosing a move.

decisions.thought: Plan: Foe Garchomp threatens EQ vs Gholdengo. Switch Scarf Garchomp to tank EQ neutrally, preserve Mimikyu disguise and Gholdengo for Rotom. Next outspeed and KO with Dragon Claw, then handle Rotom with Gholdengo immune to status.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Reviewing the battle state and move history to track Gholdengo versus Garchomp and Mimikyu's disguise status.Calculating type matchups and speed tiers to evaluate the Gholdengo versus Garchomp interaction.Evaluating type resistances and speed to weigh staying in versus switching to Mimikyu or Garchomp.Resolving damage interactions to confirm Garchomp survives and can KO with Dragon Claw.Evaluating switch options to preserve Mimikyu's disguise while ensuring Garchomp can revenge KO.

decisions.thought: Plan: Scarf outspeeds foe Garchomp. Dragon Claw 2x best, avoids Levitate switch. Likely leaves foe low, we faint back. Then Mimikyu Sneak priority cleans. Keep Gholdengo full for Rotom-Wash. Preserve Mimikyu disguise if possible.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing battle speed stats and Choice Scarf effect to determine turn order and next action.Reconciling the speed calculation to confirm the Choice Scarf multiplier ensures outspeeding.Resolving team composition inconsistency and weighing contact recoil against super-effective damage.Verifying damage calculations and confirming Mimikyu's intact Disguise for the next move.Correcting the damage formula and evaluating switch options against the opponent's Garchomp.Comparing switching to Mimikyu versus staying with Dragon Claw against the opponent's Garchomp.

decisions.thought: Plan: Switch Scarf Garchomp out to preserve for foe Garchomp. Gholdengo full walls Rotom, immune to status via Good as Gold, can Nasty Plot. Our Mimikyu disguise still intact at 80%, save it. Foe Rotom 68% Levitate, no moves seen; foe Garchomp 100% EQ only.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating locked-move constraints and damage risks to choose between staying with Dragon Claw or switching to Gholdengo or Mimikyu.Assessing type matchups and damage to weigh staying with Garchomp versus switching to Gholdengo.Evaluating switch to Gholdengo against Rotom while preserving Garchomp and Mimikyu's intact Disguise.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo walls Rotom immune to WoW. Foe likely switches to Garchomp EQ threat. Shadowball chips Rotom or Garchomp switch-in. Save Mimikyu disguise to revenge Garchomp with Play Rough, Scarf Garchomp cleans. Avoid burn on physical attackers.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo KOs Rotom with Shadowball. Then foe Garchomp comes, EQ OHKOs Gholdengo, so switch to Mimikyu disguise intact to tank and Play Rough. Keep Scarf Garchomp for cleanup. Foe Rotom WoW Sitrus used, Garchomp EQ only.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing damage ranges and speed to confirm Shadow Ball will KO Rotom before it can act.Evaluating Garchomp's Earthquake damage against Gholdengo's typing and bulk to avoid an OHKO.Choosing Shadow Ball to KO Rotom while preserving Mimikyu's disguise to later revenge Garchomp.

decisions.thought: Plan: Opp Garchomp 48% -1 SpD threatens EQ OHKO on Gholdengo. Switch Mimikyu disguise intact to block EQ free, then Play Rough KOs. Keep Scarf Garchomp 49% for Rotom 43% cleanup. Gholdengo full walls Rotom immune to WoW.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Gholdengo vs Garchomp speed and type matchup to determine if Earthquake is a likely OHKO and checking Mimikyu's disguise status from earlier turns.Comparing Mimikyu and Garchomp switch options against the 48% HP Garchomp.

decisions.thought: Plan: Play Rough KOs 48% Garchomp super-effectively. Scarf Garchomp cleans Rotom later, Gholdengo walls Rotom immune to WoW. Foe Garchomp has EQ Stone Edge, Rotom WoW Sitrus used. Mimikyu disguise now broken, Life Orb recoil noted.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Analyzing Mimikyu disguise state from battle logs to reconcile busted form HP and effect description inconsistencies.Evaluating speed and damage to determine if Play Rough can KO before taking a neutral Earthquake.

decisions.thought: Plan: Finish 8% Rotom with priority Sneak, then Play Rough KOs 48% Garchomp. Keep Scarf Garchomp to revenge, Gholdengo full walls Rotom immune to WoW. Foe has EQ Stone Edge, Rotom WoW Sitrus used.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating move options for Mimikyu vs Rotom, weighing accuracy and priority to ensure a guaranteed KO.Assessing Life Orb recoil and Garchomp speed matchup after the guaranteed KO.

decisions.thought: Plan: Foe down to last Garchomp 48%. Play Rough KOs for immediate win if faster. If slower Mimikyu falls, Scarf Garchomp Dragon Claw revenges. Gholdengo full backup. Foe has EQ Stone Edge.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating stat reset on switch and damage calculation to decide the next move.Assessing speed and damage ranges to compare a KO versus a switch risk.Evaluating damage and speed to choose between a priority chip, an all-in attack, or a switch.

decisions.thought: Plan: Last foe Garchomp 48% with EQ Stone Edge. Scarf Garchomp outspeeds and Dragon Claw KOs for win. Keep full Gholdengo as backup if needed.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating damage and speed to choose between sending Gholdengo or Choice Scarf Garchomp against opponent Garchomp.

decisions.thought: Plan: Dragon Claw KOs 48% Garchomp for win. If outsped and faint, full Gholdengo Shadow Ball cleans (did 52% before). Foe Garchomp has EQ (~94 dmg) Stone Edge. We are locked to Dragon Claw by Scarf.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating damage calculations and move effectiveness to confirm a KO decision within the word limit.Resolving type matchup and speed tie logic against a mirrored team with identical stats and items.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: Plan: Foe Garchomp at 48%, Shadow Ball did 52% before. Must KO now with stronger Make It Rain. Risk: foe may outspeed (149 vs up to 169) and EQ likely OHKOs due to Steel weakness. No alternative, attack.
